name: Monk VR
summary:
Monk VR is a multiplayer locomotion based VR game for Meta Quest. You  can mess around with your friends or just be monkeys and climb the architecture! However, you can customize and make your monkey unique using cosmetics in our shop, and even purchase Nanas to be dripped out to the max!
